_note: Visas for flying to another country (lib/visas, src/app/visa/[country]). You live in the UAE, so Dubai and Abu Dhabi need none; Doha needs a Qatar visa before you can book a flight there (public.book_flight). Fees (AED), validity and review time are charged and enforced by public.apply_visa() / public.my_visa(), mirrored exactly here and checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs.
